Press Release:


Refugee Crisis
Thousands of destitute refugees have survived the perilous journey to Europe. They’ve lost almost everything in a desperate attempt to escape the clutches of a brutal civil war in Syria. But not everyone has welcomed them with open arms. Sleeping rough at a Budapest station, they waited in vain for trains to take them to Western Europe. Finally, the hundreds of men, women and children simply got up and began to walk. Their aim? To cover the 120 kilometre route to the Austrian Border on foot. Guardian journalist and filmmaker John Domokos followed them every step of the way. Carte Blanche presents the astonishing story of a Syrian family who put a face to the refugee crisis that has Europe reeling for a politically correct response.
Producer: John Domokos (The Guardian)
